title: Echo
description: An event-driven personal agent that connects iMessage, local tools, and an AI worker across two macOS accounts.

cover.alt: Echo workspace showing connected apps and account controls

details: Echo starts with an iMessage. A separate macOS login reads and sends messages, while the main login holds the OpenAI key, agent logic, and tool connections. They communicate over authenticated loopback HTTP on the same Mac.
The agent can use connected MCP tools and return its result through Messages. The split keeps the messaging bridge away from the main login's credentials and avoids a public server.

It also saves one-time and recurring schedules. A reminder can send a simple message later, while a scheduled job can run the normal agent workflow. The private dashboard shows connections, schedules, and recent work.
